name: Athens poster prints
why: Uses your poster and screenprinting skills, and the After Hours Athens research gives you subjects people already love.
test: Design 3 prints, post them, and take preorders before printing anything.

name: Sticker packs
why: Low cost per unit and easy to ship in an envelope, so it's a low-risk first store. Stay away from UGA logos and other licensed marks.
test: Order one small sheet run and sell at a market or through a simple online store.

name: Design templates
why: Podcast cover, poster and social templates you build once and sell many times.
test: List one template pack on Etsy or Gumroad and see what gets views.

name: Print-on-demand apparel
why: You only pay when something sells, so you can test lots of designs without stock.
test: Connect a print-on-demand service to a store and launch 5 designs.
